intro_body: Stan, most people don't look for a lawyer until the day they need one. When that day comes, a name they already know has a head start. This plan makes Little & Holland that name in Oxford, with two 15-second commercials (we call them spots) on screens in clinic lobbies, salons, gyms and restaurants.

why_points.title: Full screen, 4× an hour
why_points.body: When your slot plays, Little & Holland fills the whole screen, with no ad beside yours. That's 1,500+ plays per screen a month.

why_points.title: Seen, not scrolled past
why_points.body: Unskippable and unblockable. The average visit on our network spans several loops, so one person can see both spots more than once.

why_points.title: Reach that costs less
why_points.body: Per 1,000 impressions: $2.63 network average, as low as $1.64 at scale, vs. $35 for TV and $19.51 for social (industry estimates).

why_points.title: A record for your files
why_points.body: Proof-of-play reports track each spot's plays, and you own both final videos forever: a clean record for the firm's advertising files.

concept_note: Spot A says who you are; Spot B says what to do next. Both are starting concepts: you set the final scripts, offers and disclosures, and nothing airs until you approve.
rotation_explainer: Two commercials, one package price. Spot A and Spot B play back-to-back in your 30-second slot every 15-minute loop, so each gets 30,000 plays a month at 20 screens, 60,000 at 40 and 120,000 at 80.
compliance_note: Mississippi lawyer ads fall under Rules of Professional Conduct 7.1–7.7, so each spot names a responsible attorney and shows Oxford, MS. Your firm approves every spot and handles any Mississippi Bar filing before a new or refreshed spot airs; we supply the videos, scripts, screen list and run dates. This is not legal advice.
